headline: Milwaukee's 41-Point Climb
caption:
Watch the World Series race redraw itself from Sep 27 to Oct 20.

MIL started at 26% and now sits at 67%, topping out at 69% along the way. That +41 is the biggest rise on the board. TB is the other riser, from 10% to 33%.

The hardest fall belongs to LAD: 24% at the start, as high as 37%, and now 0%. CLE (peak 20%) and NYY (peak 17%) also hit 0%. Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day, so the line moves with every result. 67% is not a lock: TB takes the title about 1 time in 3.

Which swing surprised you most?
